01 / About me

About me

I approach product work with a problem-first, outcome-driven mindset.

I believe that great products begin with a deep understanding of users rather than assumptions. I enjoy combining user research, product data, and cross-functional collaboration to uncover root causes, validate opportunities, and make informed product decisions. My passion lies in product discovery and building experiences that create lasting value for both users and the business.
